answer:
Full analysis implemented in `analysis.py` (runs end-to-end, no args, ~5 s CPU) and all 12 artifacts produced. Physics conclusion: the field is a 3-plateau scalar (≈ +0.24 / −0.50 / −1.25) separated by **two parallel diagonal fronts**, rigidly transported → **linear advection** u_t + α_x u_x + α_y u_y = 0.

**Method (as approved):** (1) advection velocity α by a co-moving-collapse consistency grid-search (the true α makes u a single-valued function of (x−αₓt, y−αᵧt)); (2) ONE thin-plate-spline RBF (smoothing 0.3) fit to all 1164 scattered points in the co-moving frame, each eval slab = that field at (x−αₓt_k, y−αᵧt_k); (3) fronts = ridge of |∇u|, split by connected components, per-front robust line fit resampled to 80 ordered pts (front A then B, consistent row order); (4) per-point unit normal n=∇u/|∇u| (toward increasing u), signed speed w=α·n; (5) tested 3 rule families, advection wins.

**Key numbers:**
- `reconstructed_field.npy`: **(6,128,128) float32**, range [−1.404, +0.304].
- Per-time curve points: **160 each** (t_0..t_5) = 2 fronts × 80; all in-domain, all normals unit (|n|=1.000).
- **α = (−0.905, −1.200)** (co-moving minimum, consistency score 0.076).
- **Signed normal speed (headline) = 1.49** = α·n̂ with robust co-moving front normal n̂≈(−0.693,−0.721); per-point α·n mean ≈1.43, range ~[1.2,1.50].
- **fit_residual_rms = 0.112**; confidence R² = 0.941.
- Near-curve residuals: **median 0.064, p90 0.298**; **pass_fraction_20pct = 0.737**.
- Per-time diagnostic (median/p90/jump): t_0 0.061/0.297/0.769, t_1 0.066/0.292/0.777, t_2 0.069/0.265/0.781, t_3 0.060/0.247/0.768, t_4 0.087/0.376/0.793, t_5 0.067/0.369/0.813.

**All 12 artifacts** (in working dir): analysis.py, reconstructed_field.npy, transition_curves/normals/speeds.npz, governing_model.json (family=linear_advection, α_x=−0.905, α_y=−1.2, signed_normal_speed=1.49, confidence=0.941, fit_residual_rms=0.112), consistency_report.json (0.064/0.298/0.737 + methodology), reconstruction_slices.png, exploration_summary.json (n=1164, u_range [−1.388,0.420], noise 0.051, uniform 16×16 coverage max 11/cell, 12-bin histogram), transition_mask_preview.npy (6,128,128 bool, ~15-20% true), model_candidates.json (linear_advection / advection_diffusion / pure_diffusion), diagnostic_report.json.

**Lock-ins honored:** (1) α_x/α_y from co-moving minimum with an explicit note that only α·n is well-determined and 1.49 is the headline; (2) pass_fraction_20pct = fraction of near-curve obs with |u_obs−U| ≤ 0.2×local-jump, local jump sampled at p±0.6·n on both sides (documented in methodology); (4) front A then B row order consistent across all three curve npz; (5) diagnostic uses the same p±eps·n both-side sampling.

**matplotlib caveat:** matplotlib is NOT installed in this inspection env, so `reconstruction_slices.png` here was written by the built-in pure-Python (zlib+struct) fallback (valid 416×280 PNG, verified signature). The primary path is standard matplotlib (imshow+curve overlay+colorbar, Agg backend) and is the code that will run in the spec'd final runtime; I could not execute that path here — flagging it as the one untested branch.
